title: Whistleblower threatened with planted child pornography before DC testimony

tellings.quote: A van pulls up SUV out in front of his house. His wife's at work and they have two young kids, boys. And the they say, "Look at your phone and your computer." And they had embedded child pornography all over it.

plain: In 2009, a whistleblower who was about to testify in Washington was frightened off when an SUV pulled up outside his house while his wife was at work and his two young boys were at home. The men in it told him to look at his phone and his computer, and he found them filled with planted child pornography. The UFO activist Steven Greer repeats this as what the man told him, as a sign of how far people will go to keep witnesses quiet.
